_notes: category -> expected_attempts baseline for the growth metric's
Categories match each exercise's 'difficulty' field (1/2/3) in the
unit JSON files. These starting numbers are illustrative placeholders,
not measured from real attempt data -- there isn't any yet. Once an
exercise has enough of its own attempt history, its own empirical
average expected_attempts should override the category default here;
everything with sparse data falls back to this table.
As of the first difficulty-rating pass (204 exercises, both tracks),
no exercise was rated 3 (hard) -- ratings were 110x easy, 94x medium.
The category-3 number below is a placeholder until that changes.
